name: desktop-connect
description: Open-source TIDAL Connect receiver for TIDAL Desktop via TidaLuna (mDNS + RemoteDesktopController).
author: dogday

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --format esm --external @luna/core --external @luna/lib --external electron && bun build src/remoteService.native.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm --external electron
